ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 Gmail web-UI C2 from a non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's ComRAT v4 (Chinch / Agent.BTZ lineage) command channel, which reads operator commands by driving the Gmail web interface over HTTPS using stolen cookies — so the connections to Google mail endpoints originate from a non-browser binary rather than Chrome/Edge/Firefox. This bidirectional-web-service dead-drop is a signature Turla (Snake / Venomous Bear / Secret Blizzard) C2 design also seen in ComRAT and Kazuar.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host="*mail.google.com*" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*gmail.com*" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*apis.google.com*") AND NOT All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","safari.exe") by All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.src host | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","safari.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","www.gmail.com","apis.google.com","accounts.google.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Conns=count(), Urls=make_set(RemoteUrl,10)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla ComRAT v4 Gmail Web C2 via Non-Browser Process
status: experimental
description: Non-browser process establishing connections to Google mail endpoints, consistent with ComRAT v4 Gmail web-UI command channel.
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'gmail.com'
      - 'apis.google.com'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\msedgewebview2.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_browsers
falsepositives:
  - Custom Google API / Gmail integration tooling or backup agents
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*mail.google.com* OR *gmail.com* OR *apis.google.com*) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IExplore.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\msedgewebview2.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mail\.google\.com|gmail\.com|apis\.google\.com)/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|opera|msedgewebview2|safari)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Ties directly to ComRAT v4's documented (ESET) design where the implant marshals commands through the Gmail web inbox over HTTPS — the C2 host is benign (Google) so domain-reputation blocks it, but the *initiator being a non-browser process* is the discriminator. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla PowerStallion/IronNetInjector — PowerShell loader staging from OneDrive WebDAV + in-memory injection
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's lightweight PowerShell backdoors (PowerStallion, IronNetInjector loaders) that mount a Microsoft OneDrive WebDAV share as their command/staging dead-drop and then reflectively load/inject a payload in memory. The combination of a OneDrive/WebDAV reference AND .NET reflective-load primitives in a single PowerShell command line is the Turla (Venomous Bear / Secret Blizzard) loader signature.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*DavWWWRoot*" OR Processes.process="*onedrive.live.com*" OR Processes.process="*1drv.ms*" OR Processes.process="*d.docs.live.net*" OR Processes.process="*@SSL*") AND (Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*Reflection.Assembly*" OR Processes.process="*VirtualAlloc*" OR Processes.process="*Marshal*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*-enc*" OR Processes.process="*EncodedCommand*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DavWWWRoot","onedrive.live.com","1drv.ms","d.docs.live.net","@SSL")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Reflection.Assembly","VirtualAlloc","Marshal","Invoke-Expression","IEX","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand","-enc ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("DavWWWRoot","onedrive.live.com","1drv.ms","d.docs.live.net","@SSL")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Reflection.Assembly","VirtualAlloc","Marshal","Invoke-Expression","IEX","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand","-enc ")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla PowerShell Loader - OneDrive WebDAV Staging with Reflective Load
status: experimental
description: PowerShell command line referencing a OneDrive/WebDAV dead-drop together with .NET reflective-load or injection primitives, consistent with Turla PowerStallion/IronNetInjector loaders.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_webdav:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DavWWWRoot'
      - 'onedrive.live.com'
      - '1drv.ms'
      - 'd.docs.live.net'
      - '@SSL'
  selection_load:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Reflection.Assembly'
      - 'VirtualAlloc'
      - 'Marshal'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
  condition: selection_img and selection_webdav and selection_load
falsepositives:
  - Admin scripts that pull modules from corporate OneDrive
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1055.001
  - attack.t1102
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:((*DavWWWRoot* OR *onedrive.live.com* OR *1drv.ms* OR *d.docs.live.net* OR *@SSL*) AND (*FromBase64String* OR *Reflection.Assembly* OR *VirtualAlloc* OR *Marshal* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *DownloadString* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *-enc*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(DavWWWRoot|onedrive\\.live\\.com|1drv\\.ms|d\\.docs\\.live\\.net|@SSL)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(FromBase64String|Reflection\\.Assembly|VirtualAlloc|Marshal|Invoke-Expression|IEX|DownloadString|-enc|EncodedCommand)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=count())
